as_told.title: Trinity crash and nuclear-related UFO crashes

plain: This story is about a crash said to have happened near the Trinity site in New Mexico, a place linked to early US nuclear testing. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says a crash there in 1945 was where a "larger piece" of strange material came from. A French researcher, Jacques Vallee, tells a fuller version he credits to the writer Paola Harris, two local men named Remy Baca and Jose Padilla, and the book Trinity: The Best-Kept Secret. In his telling, the crash was near San Antonio, New Mexico, and through an opening where one panel was missing, the boys saw three human-like creatures with two eyes. Another guest, Marik von Rennenkampf, mentions it more cautiously, saying there was "possibly" a crash at the test site and that it is unclear, and credits a man named DD Johnson and Vallee. In a later episode Michels dates it to 1948 instead and counts it as one of a string of UFO crashes near nuclear sites. If true, it would mean an unknown craft, with beings aboard, came down near the birthplace of the atomic bomb.
